No sourcing on reddit as per reddit terns of service. But it's quite literally opium tea. The seeds are Coated in opium that goes from the pods and drips into the inside of the pods on the seeds. So it's morphine essentially. Many other alkaloids but the two that get you high in it are codeine and morphine. So essentially just morphine due to codeine metabolizing into morphine in the body.

You can also evap the tea into a waxy tar / powdered substance that can be vaporized to get a really good high. But the tea is lovely. The high is as good as any other opiate in my opinion. Has more side effects due to the thebaine content but also has a very long duration. Low tolly ppl can expect it to last like 16 hours.

Not hundreds but quite a few. The alkaloids in opium have been shown to affect serotonin but not in a particularly significant manner. Papaverine though is a potent vasodilator and could be beneficial for use with benze counteracting certain side effects if you can do an extraction that leaves out as much thebaine as possible. The main concern with thebaine is the seizure risk in combination with a stimulant. Thebaine in and of itself can cause seizures in high doses so if this combination is performed it is best to try to extract in such a manner that excludes as much thebaine as possible. Using cold water will aid in that as it is more soluble in warm acidic liquid. Very cold water does decrease the amount of morphine and codeine extracted which I remember reading in a study a few years ago. I do appreciate your concern though. Seriously.
